_about: The replay-from-report pin (report quality gate G4). One replayer for every arm, chosen by the replayer pilot (replay version 3); see docs/report-quality.md. The model is the id the harness records, as in every saved replay episode. Budget (replay version 3): device ACTIONS, budget_factor x the reference route, at least budget_floor; every tool call is also capped at call_cap_factor x that, at least call_cap_floor.
